//: Copy to config.json (keep it out of git) and edit. Every coin amount is a decimal STRING in that coin's units. Keys starting with // are comments. README.md explains every field.
// acknowledgeRealFunds: live mode refuses to start unless this is true AND --confirm names the wallet address
// maxSpendUsd: the most this wallet may LOSE in the run: fees, gas, activation, trading costs, and anything sent to an address other than the wallet itself. Checked before every step.
// allowExistingAccount: a brand-new wallet is the expected start; set true to resume with --only on a wallet the runner already funded
// deposit: USDC sent from this chain to the wallet's own SoDEX deposit address. A new account keeps 1 USDC as its activation fee.
// orders: the markets the order steps trade on, at their smallest sizes. perpsCollateral: USDC moved Spot -> Perps for the perps steps (more if the market needs it), moved back after. triggerWaitSeconds: how long to wait for a take-profit placed at the market to fire (0 = do not try; not firing is reported, never a failure).
// withdrawValuechainOther: skipped unless receivers.valuechain is set to ANOTHER address you control
// extraDeposits: more USDC deposits from other EVM chains the wallet is funded on, e.g. { "chain": "BASE_ETH", "amount": "5" }
// extraWithdrawals: per chain: the token AND the native coin where both are offered. buyIfMissing market-buys the missing amount on Spot first (fee + spread; the rest stays in Spot).
// receivers: the ONLY addresses other than the wallet itself that anything may be sent to. XRP/XLM: { "address": "r...", "memo": "123" } or { "address": "r...", "noMemo": true }. Profile all-chains: your OWN address per chain the runner cannot sign on, named by the chain key in lower case (sol, btc, ltc, doge, ada, sui, ton, xlm, xrp) - a route without one is skipped.
// evmTour: profiles evm-tour and all-chains: "chains": "all" or a list of chain keys; "skip": chain keys to leave out (e.g. "ETH" for mainnet gas); sellBack: sell what the tour bought back to USDC after the last chain that needs it
// chainWithdrawals: profile all-chains: per route on a chain the runner cannot sign on, the smallest amount you could send straight back, to receivers.<chain>; buyIfMissing market-buys the coin on Spot first
// manualDeposits: profile all-chains, opt-in per route: deposits YOU send by hand, e.g. { "coin": "SOL", "chain": "SOL", "amount": "auto" } (auto: the round trip the runner plans - never below SoDEX's deposit minimum, your wallet's fee on top), "skip": true = left out (reported skipped (owner)). The run shows the verified address and waits for Spot to rise by the amount; typing s + Enter skips one. The guided full test writes these for you.
// builder: OFF (null) by default. To test the Valuescan builder fee and its tiers (docs/BUILDER-TIERS.md section 8) set e.g. { "id": 12345, "address": "0x<builder account's WALLET ADDRESS - never a key>", "feePerps": 20, "feeSpot": 20, "maxFee": 20, "required": true, "revokeAtEnd": true, "termsKeys": ["<the server's terms PUBLIC key, base64url of 32 bytes>"] }. Fees in tenths of a basis point (perps 0..200, spot 0..2000). required: a build with a builder requires the approval (G1) - false only to test an optional build. address: lets the cross-check reconcile the builder account's income. termsKeys: with them builder-tiers runs (default fee, verified volume, the lower fee, two cheating orders, the approval enforced); the SAME wallet can show the default fee only once - reset it with `npx tsx tools/builderTiers.ts forget --address <wallet>` in apps/server. expectTier (optional): { "atUsd": 10, "perps": 15, "spot": 20 } - else the tier the server announces is asserted. Find the id with: node tools/check-builder.mjs <builder wallet>
// timeouts: verifierMinutes: how long to wait for the server to verify the volume after a hint. addressIssueSeconds: how long a live run waits for a new wallet's deposit addresses. streamSeconds: how long to wait for the account stream to report a fill before leaving it to the final cross-check.
